summary: BW LPG Ltd filed a Form 6-K with an attached press release announcing the upcoming publication of its Q2 2026 financial report on 28 August 2026 and an accompanying earnings presentation led by CEO Kristian Sørensen and CFO Samantha Xu. The filing includes only routine scheduling details, event logistics via Zoom, and company background. No special-situation transaction, strategic action, or material corporate event is disclosed. The filing is a standard earnings-date notice under Form 6-K, equivalent to a routine current report for a foreign private issuer, and does not warrant classification as a special situation.
